visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue denim shirt and black pants, is sitting on gray stone steps outdoors at night. She is seen rubbing a long black sword against the sole of her bare foot. (2) A man wearing a black hooded robe with white traditional patterns and a circular dragon emblem on the chest appears, looking surprised with wide eyes and open hands. (3) A close-up shows the woman's foot being rubbed vigorously by the sword, creating a fictional context of sharpening. (4) The man holds a shorter sword or dagger, admiring its blade in a close-up, while looking impressed. (5) The woman speaks with a sad facial expression, looking down at her hands while sitting on the same stone steps. (6) A young girl with glasses and pigtails, wearing a white patterned vest over a plaid shirt, walks in carrying a large gift box. (7) The man presents the gift box, which is white with floral illustrations and labeled "La glow Foot Cream Set". (8) A series of close-up product shots show a textured black and gold foot care tool and jars of white cream. (9) The man demonstrates the use of a gold foot care tool on the woman's heel, which is now resting on a white surface indoors. (10) The woman is now indoors on a gray sofa, applying white cream from a jar labeled "La glow Foot Cream" onto her feet. (11) Close-up shots show a spoon lifting white cream from a jar and the woman pulling on a pair of pink socks with white floral patterns. (12) The woman sits on the sofa, showing off her smooth feet with gold glitter nail polish. (13) The scene shifts back outdoors where the woman hugs the man in the robe. (14) The young girl warns the man with an intense expression. (15) The man draws a sword dramatically against a dark architectural background.

(2) A sudden sharp "whoosh" transition SFX occurs as the man appears. The BGM shifts to an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong synth beat. (3) The man's voice is high arousal, loud, and comedically shocked. (4) A grinding sound effect is played as the sword touches the foot. (5) During the product introduction, the man's tone shifts to a professional promotional narrative style. "Ding" and "Sparkle" sound effects highlight key product features. (6) A young girl's voice interrupts with a high-pitched, warning tone. (7) The video concludes with a metallic "shing" sound effect of a sword being drawn and a final upbeat musical flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous martial arts/wuxia parody to promote the 'La Glow Foot Cream Set'. It captures attention with a bizarre opening (sharpening a sword on a foot) and transitions into an informative product demonstration highlighting ease of use and effective skin smoothing.
